I’ll check the Anthropic streaming adapter and its tests, then fix the tool-call indexing and finish events. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
The streaming path uses Anthropic’s content-block index as the choice index, hardcodes every tool-call index to zero, and repeats the finish chunk for each block. I’ll add a per-response tool-call index mapping and emit the finish chunk once, with tests covering parallel calls and intervening text blocks.
The regression cases passed. The test run then hit a sandbox permission error in the repository’s final process-reporting hook. I’ll capture the results in a report to confirm the full Anthropic test-file outcome.
Fixed Anthropic streaming to number tool calls sequentially from 0, independent of text blocks, keep every chunk in choice 0, and emit one finish event per response. Non-streaming behavior is unchanged.

Added regression coverage for parallel calls and mixed text/tool blocks. All 73 Anthropic tests passed; pytest exited with a sandbox permission error in its final process-reporting hook.

diff --git a/tests/gateway/providers/test_anthropic.py b/tests/gateway/providers/test_anthropic.py
index 24cd52cff..13c9b40d8 100644
--- a/tests/gateway/providers/test_anthropic.py
+++ b/tests/gateway/providers/test_anthropic.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import json
 from unittest import mock
 
 import pytest
@@ -763,6 +764,98 @@ def chat_function_calling_stream_response():
     ]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "block_types",
+    [
+        [],
+        ["text", "text"],
+        ["tool_use", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use", "text", "tool_use"],
+    ],
+)
+async def test_chat_stream_content_block_indices(block_types):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "test-id",
+                "model": "claude-2.1",
+                "usage": {"input_tokens": 25},
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    expected_tool_calls = []
+    for block_index, block_type in enumerate(block_types):
+        if block_type == "tool_use":
+            tool_id = f"toolu_{block_index}"
+            location = f"city_{block_index}"
+            block = {"type": "tool_use", "id": tool_id, "name": "get_weather", "input": {}}
+            deltas = [
+                {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": '{"location":'},
+                {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": f'"{location}"}}'},
+            ]
+            expected_tool_calls.append(
+                {"id": tool_id, "name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"location": location}}
+            )
+        else:
+            block = {"type": "text", "text": ""}
+            deltas = [{"type": "text_delta", "text": "Checking weather."}]
+        events.append(
+            {"type": "content_block_start", "index": block_index, "content_block": block}
+        )
+        events.extend(
+            {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": block_index, "delta": delta}
+            for delta in deltas
+        )
+        events.append({"type": "content_block_stop", "index": block_index})
+    events.extend(
+        [
+            {
+                "type": "message_delta",
+                "delta": {"stop_reason": "tool_use" if expected_tool_calls else "end_turn"},
+                "usage": {"output_tokens": 15},
+            },
+            {"type": "message_stop"},
+        ]
+    )
+    resp = [f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n".encode() for event in events]
+    with mock.patch(
+        "aiohttp.ClientSession.post", return_value=MockAsyncStreamingResponse(resp)
+    ) as mock_post:
+        provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+        payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+        mock_post.assert_called_once()
+
+    assert all(len(chunk.choices) == 1 and chunk.choices[0].index == 0 for chunk in chunks)
+    assert [chunk.choices[0].finish_reason for chunk in chunks] == [None] * (len(chunks) - 1) + [
+        "stop"
+    ]
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.prompt_tokens == 25
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.completion_tokens == 15
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.total_tokens == 40
+
+    tool_calls = []
+    for chunk in chunks:
+        for tool_call in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls or []:
+            if tool_call.id is not None:
+                assert tool_call.index == len(tool_calls)
+                assert tool_call.type == "function"
+                tool_calls.append(
+                    {"id": tool_call.id, "name": tool_call.function.name, "arguments": ""}
+                )
+            else:
+                tool_calls[tool_call.index]["arguments"] += tool_call.function.arguments
+    for tool_call in tool_calls:
+        tool_call["arguments"] = json.loads(tool_call["arguments"])
+    assert tool_calls == expected_tool_calls
+    assert "".join(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "" for chunk in chunks) == (
+        "Checking weather." * block_types.count("text")
+    )
+
+
 @pytest.mark.asyncio
 async def test_chat_function_calling_stream():
     resp = chat_function_calling_stream_response()

+def test_get_model_version_by_alias_latest_picks_highest_version(store):
+    model_name = "GetModelVersionByAliasLatest_TestMod"
+    store.create_registered_model(model_name)
+    for _ in range(4):
+        store.create_model_version(model_name, "path/to/source", uuid.uuid4().hex)
+    # `get_latest_versions` returns the latest version of each stage, keyed by the
+    # stage of the lowest version that reached it, so the highest version is neither
+    # the first nor the last element here.
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "1", "Archived", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "2", "Production", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "3", "Staging", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "4", "Production", False)
+
+    mv = store.get_model_version_by_alias(model_name, "latest")
+    assert int(mv.version) == 4
+
+
+def test_get_model_version_by_alias_latest_after_promoting_older_version(store):
+    model_name = "GetModelVersionByAliasLatestPromoteOlder_TestMod"
+    store.create_registered_model(model_name)
+    for _ in range(3):
+        store.create_model_version(model_name, "path/to/source", uuid.uuid4().hex)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "1", "Production", False)
+
+    mv = store.get_model_version_by_alias(model_name, "latest")
+    assert int(mv.version) == 3
